verification_profile.playwright_authorization: No frontend codebase is in scope. Phase -1A discovery found no frontend markers (no package.json with a frontend framework dep, no .tsx/.jsx/.vue/.svelte sources); the target is a Claude Code plugin repo of Markdown instruction surfaces plus stdlib-only Python. Phase -1D interaction-intuition is a documented no-op for the same reason. Recording this N/A explicitly per the Phase 1 gate rule rather than leaving it silent.
verification_profile.dev_api_authorization: The change ships no HTTP surface, no server, and no database. There is no endpoint to call, no payload to post, and no dev environment to stand up, so the dev-api-integration-testing criteria have no referent. The analogous real-execution bar for this repo is (a) the default pytest suite executed against the real modules with no mocks of CT6's own code, and (b) the opt-in CT6_EVALS=1 behavioral tier executing a real model against marker-bearing fixtures. Both are bound as acceptance criteria below.
verification_profile.frontend_e2e: n/a — no frontend file will be touched by any task in tasks.md
